final: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_count FROM store_counts), shares AS (SELECT sc.store_id, sc.customer_count, 1.0 * sc.customer_count / t.total_count AS share FROM store_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(customer_count) AS average_count FROM shares) SELECT s.store_id, s.customer_count, s.share, 1.0 * s.customer_count / a.average_count FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL
